en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a small town surrounded by fields and low hills, seen from a rocky, wooded vantage point. In the foreground are pitched-roof houses among trees; beyond them stretches a compact settlement of wooden and masonry houses, barns, and a church or industrial buildings, with open countryside in the distance. The lower left corner bears printed caption text, and a small publisher's logo with a number appears in the lower right corner.
